tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (783)zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo gsol mchod kyi rim pa bzhugs/(784)bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ga
(783)zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo gsol mchod kyi rim pa bzhugs/(784)bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ga

tei:div.tei:p: (783)zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo gsol mchod kyi rim pa bzhugs/ (784)

bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ gtsug lag khang dang dben gnas kyi/ rten dang dkor la rang gar za/ dgra jag chom pos 'jigs pa'i tshe/ e ka tsa ṭī'i las mkhan ma/ zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo 'di/ brten pas chog pa'i dkor srung yin/ chags pa'i thabs la brten rdzas gces/ mi 'bral ba la bla rdor gces/ mchod pa la ni dam rdzas gces/ than dang srog la thod pa gces/ de dag gzhung du shes byas nas/ thod pa'am ni (785) bse bor nang*/ dmar gtor zur gsum bshos bu dang*/ mthob kyu bcu'am re res skor/ ra lug rta gong sha khrag brgyan/ skyems dang 'o chol nyer spyod bsham/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo'am/ khros ma nag mo'i ting nge 'jin gyis/ bhyoḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki ni/ nyi ma byang shar pha ki na/ dur khrod chen po gsang lung na/ dug mtsho khol ma'i nang shed na/ byang brag ldem pa'i pho brang (786)na/ ma mo gnod sbyin mjes ldan ma/ gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma khyed/ mkhas btsun dkor gyi bdag mo yin/ khyed kyi yab la mtshan gsol ba/ yab ni 'od de 'od po che/ khyed kyi yum la mtshan gsol ba/ yum ni lha bzang a mo lcam/ de gnyis gangs dkar stongs su bshos/ srid pa'i lcam sring brgyad du srid/ che zhes lha mo ngan ne ma/ dmar mo dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ g.yas g.yon lcags kyu me long (787)'jin/ dar nag go zu gtsug phud can/ de 'og klu mo nor la ngan/ lcags kyus 'jin zhing phur bus sgrol/ de 'og gnod sbyin rdzas la ngan/ lcags kyus 'gugs shing bum par bskyil/ de 'og 'dre mo zas la ngan/ mi lpags gyon nas ro langs zhon/ lag na mchog phur lcags phu thogs/ dral po de ni mi rings skyes/ de 'og bse mdung dmar po can/ de 'og shan pa ra mgo nag tha chung zu ra ra (788)skyes ni/ mi nag rta nag mdung thung can/ lcam dral brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/

bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir/ rig 'jin rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ lhang lhang 'bod de tser tser byon/ hūm̐ ra li pra ma ya jaḥja si li ma ni jaḥ zhes bzlas pas myur du 'ong*/ bhyoḥ 'jig rten 'phrul gyi lha mo khyod/ zas dang dkor gyi bdag mo mjad/ rin chen gter la mnga' sgyur ba/ nor gyi bdag mo rdzu 'phrul can/ nor gdung che zhing (789)nor la brtse/ nor srung rgyal mo dbang gi lha/ bang mjod lha mo gzi brjid can/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ bos so dkor srung snyan ma sra/ g.yab po dkaro srung spyan ma rdul/ do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong*/ do nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems 'bul/ grogs mor 'bod de da tshur spyon/ mja' mor 'bod do dam la 'du/ bsad pa'i dgra sha gtor mar 'bul/ (790)btsos pa'i gser skyems mchod par bzhes/ bsgral ba'i raktas thugs dam bskang*/ dam tshig nyams dang gnas rten 'phrog dkor la brku ba'i don snying gis/ dur khrod lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ klu mo nor snyeg thugs dam bskang*/ gnod sbyin nor srung thugs dam bskang*/ 'dre 'bod nag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ dkor srung rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ ming po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ ming sring brgyad po gtor ma bzhes/ sha khrag dmar (791)gi mchod pa bzhes/ mi phor 'o phud mchod pa bzhes/ gser skyems chang gi mchod pa bzhes/ 'o chol dkar gsum mngar gsum dang 'dres pa phug ron gyi dang rus gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ ra li pra ma ya stu tsa ba lingta khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis bsngo/ de nas re ma ti mchod bzhi'i sprul pa dur khrod brgyad kyi ngan ne ma mchod pa ni/ bhyoḥ dur khrod chen po gtum drag nas/ rdo rje pho nya gtor ma longs/ tshang tshing 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas/ rdo rje ro langs gtor ma (792)longs/ dur khrod 'ur 'ur 'bar ba nas/ rdo rje drag rtsal gtor ma longs/

dur khrod chen po 'jigs rung nas/ ka li nag mo gtor ma longs/ dur khrod nags tshal 'jigs rung nas/ nag mo lag ring gtor ma longs/ mun pa mi bzad dur khrod nas/ sha za nag mo gtor ma longs/ dur khrod kī li'i sgra sgrogs nas/ byi to ta ma gtor ma longs/ dur khrod ha ha sgrogs pa nas/ las byed nag mo gtor ma longs/ siṅga la (793)yi dur khrod nas/ nag mo rab 'jigs ma la sogs/ kun kyang khyed kyi sprul pa yin/ nor srang gang gi phyir 'breng zhing*/ rtswa phyag gang gi rjes gcod ma/ khyed la gtsug lag khang 'di gnyer/ sems med 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i/ gnod pa sna tshogs bsrung nus na/ gzugs can ming dang gzugs med kyis/ log par 'dren la smos ci dgos/ gnas rten bsrung la yon bdag (794)gyis/ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ yun du gnas pa'i phrin las mjod/ rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs dang*/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa'i dgra de dag khyod kyi zas skal du/ gtad pa'i dam tshig dran gyis la/ lo zlar ma bzhag myur du sgrol/ khyed ni mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bdag gang la sems pa khyed shes kyis/ rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig dang*/ padma 'byung gnas bka' ma gcog bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor (795)bcas kyis/ thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis na/ nad rims dal kha'i rngur ma gtang*/ 'khon dang god kha dgra la bsgyur/ bar gcod zhi zhing tshe dpal rgyas/ lha mi'i 'du ba rgyun ma gcad/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mjod/ las sgrub dmigs bsal la bskul bya dgos na dmar gtor bzang po sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams la/ khrag chang dang 'o phud 'thor zhing*/ ma bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ bhyo bhyo nor rkun phyil bhyo/ (796)dur khrod chen po gsang lung na/ nags tshal gnam la zangs se zang*/ dug mtsho khol ma chi li li/ sha khrag nang khrol rongs se rong*/ mi ro mang po lings se ling*/ ro langs mchongs rgyug ta la la/

keng rus lhu dum khro lo lo/ de na su bzhugs su mi bzhugs/ de na ro zan nag mo bzhugs/ dur khrod bdag mo de na bzhugs/ shan pa nag mo de na bzhugs/ gcer bu'i lus la nag mo'i gzugs/ snum dang khrag (797)gi thig les brgyan/ ral nag ma ral sig cing rgyug ral pa re la mi lag re/ mi lag lan tshar khro lo lo/ ro yi shun pa gos su gyon/ thod pa ja ril mgo la brgyan/ thod chung mgo phreng se ral kha/ mtshan ma bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs/ kha nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod/ nor rkun khang mtha' bskor zhing rgyug nor rkun ming nas lhang lhang 'bod/ 'o dod chen po gnam du gtong*/ (798)mi lpags g.yab mo pa la rdeb/ zhing gi lpags pa gos su gyon/ ro la zhon nas har rgyug byed/ rlung la zhon nas grib po 'grim/ sdang mig bgrad nas dkor nor gzigs/ zas nor gang khyer bya ra mjad/ nam gung 'grims nas dkor rjes gcod/ 'grul pyir 'brangs nas cho 'phrul gtong*/ skad phyir 'brangs nas mal du rgyug 'dre gnon gtong zhing grang rdul 'bebs/ skra nas 'then zhing steng nas gnon/ tsitta 'byin (799)cing snying khrag 'thung/ srog rtsa gcod cing sha rus gtubs/ sna nas nad kyi rlangs pa 'thul/ rims nad yams nad char du 'bebs/ kha dbugs 'gog cing mig rtsa gcod/ khong srog gcod cing sred srangs gagatong*/ ro la za zhing mi ro sred/ khrag la 'thungs shing rkan sgra rdeb/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ nor rkun ma rungs smyo ru chug gsod byed nag mo'i dus la bab/ ma bhyoḥ dur khrod lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ gcer bu lus (800)la ma ral gyon/ la la gcer bu mi lpags gyon/ la la mi lpags g.yab mo rdeb/ la la khrag gi zor 'da' 'phen/ la la skra 'then steng nas gnon/ la la snying 'byin lto tshil drung*/ nag mo chen mo rdzu 'phrul can/ ro langs zhon nas har rgyug 'byon/ dur khrod lha mo spu gri ma/ rlung la zhon nas grib so 'grim/

kha nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod/ dgra bo'i ming 'bod lhangs se lhang*/ nor snyeg mang po sha ra ra/ thod pa'i rnga (801)brdung ldi ri ri/ nag mo zor 'phen chems se chem/ ma mo'i tsham rngams zings se zing*/ 'dre mo'i 'dre gnon nems se nem/ dgra la g.yab 'debs rubs se rub/ nor rkun dam nyams las ngan 'di/ mal nas gcer bur khrid la shog snying rlung che nge 'debs su chug nag mo chen mo drag shul can/ gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma khyod/ bka' dang bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ mkhas btsun dkor gyi (802)srung ma khyed/ dkor nor gang khyer bya ra mjod/ khyed ni nor gyi bdag mo ste/ nor gdung tshe zhing nor la brtse/ dkor bdag chen mo drag shul can/ gser srang gang dang nor srang dod/ mjo rta gar khyer phyir 'breng ma/ nas phul gang dang rtswa phyag gang*/ ci dang ci khyer rjes gcod ma/ dgra la 'o dod ngu 'bod rgyob/ lhang lhang tser tser ming nas bos/ dkor rkun gang yin khug la shog srog rtsa dmar 'byin rbad chod thong*/ snying rtsa dmar 'byin (803)hur 'don gyis/ sha khrag ma lus sring mos rol/ nag mo spu gri'i dus la bab/ klu mo nor snyeg dus la bab/ gnod sbyin nag mo skad gtong ma/ khang mtha' bskor zhing 'o dod bos/ 'dre mo nag mo sgo brdung ma/ dgra bo'i khang khyim bshig la shog nag mo chen mo mim zan ma/ dgra bo'i snying khrag chod la shog dur khrod lha mo'i dus la bab/ do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ de ring nga yi nor phyir 'breng*/ (804)nor kun gang yin khrid la shog sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ ma mo'i nag mo'i dus la bab/ bhyoḥ dur khrod bdag mo dgra la bhyo/ dkor nor srung ma dgra la bhyo/ ma bdud nag mo dgra la bhyo/ ming sring bdun po dgra la bhyo/ mi dmar skyes cig dgra la bhyo/ mi rungs dmar po dgra la bhyo/ shan pa ra mgo dgra la bhyo/ zu ra ra skyes dgra la bhyo/ bhyo bhyo dgra bo'i srog la bhyo/

bhyo bhyo dgra bo'i sha la bhyo/ bhyo bhyo dgra ba'i khrag la (805)bhyo/ dgra bo'i sha la hab zas kyis/ dgra bo'i khrag la hub 'thung gyis/ dgra bo'i srog la bskul ma gyis/ dgra sha dum bur gtubs pa 'dis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra khrag nang rol g.yos pa 'dis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i don snying glo mchin gyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i rtsa khrag khog dbugs kyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam (806)bskang*/ dgra bo'i mi nor longs spyod kyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i mjo g.yag rta phyugs kyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i ba glang ra lug gis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i bang mjod dkor nor gyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ dgra bo'i lo tog rmug yab kyis/ ming sring brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang*/ bzhes shig dur khrod lha mo'i tshogs/ rol cig (807)dur khrod lha mo'i tshogs/ khyer cig las mkhan shan pa'i tshogs/ choms shig ming po sde bzhi po/ dgra bo'i mi nor longs spyod kyi/ thugs dam skong ngo phrin las mjod/ hūm̐ da li pra ma ya ja ja/ ma hā kā li padma hur hur kro ta ni hur hur rbad bhyo/ dgra bo'i tsitta phyung phyung*/ srog la rbad rbad/ tsitta gtubs gtubs/ tsitta lcibs lcibs/ tsitta rmugs rmugs/ tsitta myogs myogs/ khrag la rbud ling*/ (808)snying khrag rbub rbud/ si li ma ni ja jaḥ dgra bo'i lus dang mkhar khyim kun/ phar thal tshur thal song bar bsam/ lcags kyi srog rtsa yod kyang chod/ bab col byas na rang la sdigs/ bde stong byung na cho 'phrul sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā li si li si li mā ra ya hūm̐ jaḥ si li si li ma ni jaḥ ma hā kā li padma har har kro ta ni la hur hur/ chom rkun rbad rbad/ dun dan bhyo bhyo/

sing sing*/ yer pa yer pa/ 'dus pa 'dus pa/ pra pa pra pa/ lhang lhang*/ tser tser/ bos bos/ rgyug rgyug (809)(810)breng breng*/ nga'i nor khyer la shog oṃ sarba ja ya rbad swa ha/ zhes bzlas pas dgra la 'dre 'bod dngos su yong*/ shin tu zab la lag len gnad yig la brten par gces so/ dus kyi tha mar dben gnas gnyen po'i rten bsrung ba'i ched du padma 'od gling du bla rdo srog 'khor 'du byas shing gnyer du gtad pa'i tshe rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rjes gu ru padma'i man ngag las byung ba/ 'khu ldog dang nus pa shin tu che bar 'dug pas gang dran du ma gyer ba gces so/// /
